question: When did Italian traveller Marco Polo visit Kerala?
solution:
The correct answer is __**13th **__CE [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Italian **explorer Marco Polo visited Kerala in 1292 CE**
 
• **Polo landed on India's Coromandel Coast in 1292** while returning home from China. 
 
• He **visited the Tamil Pandya Kingdom, which is near Tanjore.**
 
• He **also travelled to southern India during the reign of Rudramma Devi of the Kakatiya Dynasty. **
 
• Polo observed the thriving trade, industries, and economic activities in southern India during the late 13th century.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• He also mentioned the Jewish colonies that existed during the 13th century. 
 
• **Visit to St. Thomas' tomb**
 
• Polo **visited the tomb of St. Thomas in Mylapore. **
 
• Marco Polo's epic journey to China was a big con – Team ...
 
• Polo was a Venetian merchant, explorer, and writer. He spent more than a year in South India, observing the local customs and trade practices.
